categories.main_business_segments: Daewon Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in pharmaceutical manufacturing and sales, including new drugs, improved new drugs, and generic drugs supplied mainly to domestic hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies. It also engages in contract manufacturing (CMO) for other pharmaceutical companies, exports finished pharmaceuticals and medical devices globally, and operates consumer healthcare and health functional food businesses through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced GMP-grade production facilities with specialized formulation technologies, including solid, liquid, and injectable dosage forms. It emphasizes proprietary drug delivery systems (DDS), synthetic new drug development, and biopharmaceutical research. Production capacity is managed with detailed planning and efficiency improvements, including overtime work as needed, and the company holds multiple patents on pharmaceutical compositions and manufacturing methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and other pharmaceutical companies for contract manufacturing. The company serves the domestic pharmaceutical market predominantly, with exports to approximately 30 countries across Southeast Asia, Middle East, Latin America, Africa, and others. It also targets consumers through its general OTC medicines and health functional foods, and supplies medical devices such as hearing aids.
categories.geographic_coverage: Daewon Pharmaceutical operates mainly in South Korea with headquarters and R&D centers in Seoul and production plants in Gyeonggi-do and Chungcheongbuk-do. Its export markets include Vietnam, the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia, Brazil, Mexico, Peru, Mongolia, China, Russia, and African countries, reflecting a broad international presence focused on Asia, Latin America, and emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug development, manufacturing, and direct sales. It also functions as a contract manufacturer for other pharmaceutical firms and engages in distribution to healthcare providers. Additionally, it produces and sells finished consumer healthcare products and medical devices, positioning itself close to the end customer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Daewon Pharmaceutical prioritizes R&D investment in innovative new drugs, improved formulations, and biopharmaceuticals, with active clinical trials for multiple pipeline candidates targeting diseases such as hyperlipidemia, uterine fibroids, non-small cell lung cancer, diabetes, and obesity. The company operates multiple research centers focusing on synthetic drugs, drug delivery systems, and health functional foods, aiming to strengthen its product portfolio and sustain long-term growth through innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of pharmaceutical products, including prescription drugs, OTC medicines, and health functional foods. Additional income streams include contract manufacturing services for other pharmaceutical companies and sales of medical devices like hearing aids. The company also engages in licensing agreements and exports, contributing to its diversified revenue base.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Daewon Pharmaceutical competes with major Korean pharmaceutical companies such as Yuhan Corporation, Chong Kun Dang, Green Cross, Daewoong Pharmaceutical, and Hanmi Pharmaceutical. It holds a solid market position with annual sales exceeding 500 billion KRW, ranking among the top 20 domestic pharmaceutical firms. The company leverages its specialized product lines and R&D capabilities to maintain competitiveness in a fragmented and highly regulated market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Daewon Pharmaceutical reported consolidated revenues of approximately 527 billion KRW, showing steady growth over recent years. The company has increased its capital base through multiple stock issuances and maintains a credit rating of A+. Despite some fluctuations in operating profit margins due to increased R&D investments and post-pandemic market conditions, the firm demonstrates a stable financial scale and positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Daewon Pharmaceutical emphasizes its advanced GMP-certified manufacturing facilities, specialized formulation technologies, and a diversified product portfolio including innovative new drugs and improved generics. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, a broad domestic sales network focused on professional healthcare providers, and strategic expansion into consumer healthcare and international markets. The company also highlights its commitment to quality, regulatory compliance, and sustainable growth through continuous innovation.
